title: EPCIS event to VSC SEAL mapping with explicit outcomes
description: The bounded projection of one retained EPCIS 2.0.1 event into the existing vsc-draft-compat@0.1.0 SEAL, as packages/vsc mapEpcisEventWithReport implements it and spec/epcis-interoperability.md section 3 defines it. Every mapping returns one of lossless, transformed, unsupported or insufficient-data with its losses or missing inputs named; the source event is retained in the signed round-trip extension and the exact source bytes and pointer are named in the signed source reference urn:bsv:dpp:epcis-source:1. Mapping never issues: issuance needs the actual issuer, key, role, jurisdiction, status and custody evidence and the complete SEAL must pass the VSC profile unchanged.

standards.name: GS1 EPCIS
standards.scope: The five event types and their identifier, time, place, step, disposition and action members.

standards.name: GS1 Core Business Vocabulary
standards.scope: Business steps and dispositions carried as the JSON binding spells them; a disposition the VSC custody model does not name is unsupported, never substituted.

standards.name: VSC draft compatibility profile
standards.scope: The SEAL structure, custody state model and correction rules the mapped credential must satisfy unchanged.

artefacts.notes: The mapped SEAL validates against the owned schema before it is returned.

inputs.format: one event of a retained EPCISDocument or EPCISQueryDocument, with its pointer, source digest and pinned context digests
issuer DID, assertion method, actor role, jurisdiction, issuance time, credential status entry, custody chain and, for a TransformationEvent, the explicit action decision
inputs.notes: Every option is the signing issuer's own evidence, never read from the event.

outputs.format: mapping outcome, missing inputs, unmapped semantics, preserved members and the unsigned SEAL when one exists
vsc-seal-json-v1 without proof, carrying the round-trip extension urn:bsv:vsc:vocab:epcis-roundtrip:0.1.0 and the source reference urn:bsv:dpp:epcis-source:1
outputs.notes: Issuance, status, authority, custody evaluation and anchoring are separate steps under the VSC profile and the registry contract.

mappingLimits.reason: Several product identifiers are carried in what.productIdentifiers, but linear custody continuity and subject scope are evaluated per identifier by the VSC profile; a multi-product event is not a custody step for any one product.
A TransformationEvent carries no action; the action in the SEAL is the caller's explicit decision, not a source fact. Without the decision the mapping is unsupported.
A disposition outside the VSC custody model (for example in_progress, sellable_accessible, damaged) has no custody state; the event stays evidence only.
An observation with no custody transition (an inspection, a repair, a sensor reading) is retained; the VSC profile's Q-state rules are not changed to admit it.
Sensor reports, their units and metadata are retained in the round-trip extension only; the event vector carries no measurement.
Owning and possessing party lists are retained, never projected into who: the SEAL's actor is the signing issuer and a named party is not attributed with the event.
Business transaction references are retained in the round-trip extension only.
Quantity lists and their units are retained; the SEAL's single quantity is not populated from a list.
Set and unset persistent dispositions are retained, not evaluated.
ILMD is retained under its own keys without interpretation.
A certificationInfo reference is retained; it is not certification evidence until separately verified.
An EPCIS error declaration is retained and reported; it is not a VSC correctionOf and grants no correction authority.
The transformation identifier linking stages is retained in the extension; the VSC chain does not carry it.
An event-level @context is retained; only the document-level pinned context enters the digest and the mapping.
Members outside the five event types' schema are retained verbatim under extension:<name> and never interpreted.
Missing eventTime, eventTimeZoneOffset, bizStep, disposition, recordTime (with no recordedAt) or product identifiers are never fabricated.

unsupported.reason: A mapping result is not a credential; issuing the SEAL is a separately authorised operation with its own issuer, status, authority and custody inputs.
No mapped event invokes Issue, Update, Transfer or Retire; shipping, receiving or owning-party fields never establish token authority or acceptance.
A VSC correction requires the existing issuer or delegation, chain and reason evidence; an EPCIS error declaration alone does not create one.

A SEAL signed by this service attests to receipt and mapping of a report; it does not assert that the service performed the physical event and the source reporter is named only in the retained extension.
